quantization_scope.routing: natural top-k routing; exposure counts include replay and are not a route trace
quantization_scope.common_master: Entire AWQ-smoothed unquantized model, including attention, experts, norms and routers

storage_plan.note: prepare_quantization.py rechecks available bytes per filesystem before calibration and both saves; sidecars need additional space

identity_contract.awq_quality_and_performance: Use output/checkpoint_manifest.json for the same calibrated AWQ sidecars in quality and serving; verify actual output shard hashes
identity_contract.fp8_quality_and_performance: Use common_basis_bf16_output/checkpoint_manifest.json for native per-expert FP8 sidecars shared by quality and serving; never substitute original unsmoothed BF16
identity_contract.matched_nonexpert_host: FP8-only, AWQ-only and dual-format worker arms load the identical complete common-BF16 master with the same BF16 stock loader options; do not globally quantize only one host model
identity_contract.basis: Both manifests and every layer artifact must agree on actual post-attention norm bytes/epsilon; worker rechecks its loaded norm
identity_contract.nonexpert_limit: The full compressed AWQ checkpoint also quantizes attention and is a distinct evaluation scope; it cannot replace the common-BF16 host in an expert-only format comparison
identity_contract.quality_status: Not run; coverage and router compensation are mechanism checks only

stop_conditions: run_locked timeout at7200 seconds; preserve partial files/logs, do not overwrite or retry automatically
any source hash, missing expert exposure, finite-value, router compensation, saved-basis or saved-layout failure

sidecars.gpu_execution: Add --execute --lock-status runs/<unique-export-job>/status.json inside run_locked. Native FP8 quantization, Marlin repacking and optional numeric checks use GPU.

local_preservation: After each bounded job, copy runs/logs/manifests and new checkpoint/artifact outputs to local storage and verify hashes before releasing rented storage. This launcher never deletes remote results.
resource_change_reason: Initial live layer0 search showed about7 seconds/grid step for20 shared-norm candidates, plus66 other mappings. Stopped prior1800s attempt early; retain identical512x512 calibration and use7200s cap within20h total GPU budget.
